sources.title: Aron C. Wall, A proof of the generalized second law for rapidly changing fields and arbitrary horizon slices, Physical Review D 85, 104049 (2012), arXiv:1105.3445v6
sources.locator: Complete 44-page article; §1, equations (1)–(3); §§2.1–2.8, especially §2.5, equations (38)–(43), and §2.8, equation (50).
sources.reading_extent: The complete PDF was retrieved in batch 114 and its relevant argument was read there. In this turn the complete arXiv PDF text was opened and §§2.5–2.8 were inspected, including the finite identity, the horizon/outside extension, and the expressly assumed renormalized decomposition.

contents.name: §1, equations (1)–(3): generalized-entropy terms and outside entropy

source_review.read_extent: The full introductory definition and discussion of the area and outside terms and the outside-entropy divergence were inspected.
source_review.supports: Provides physical context for separating geometric and outside contributions and for fixing a finite subtraction scheme.
source_review.limitations: Wall's causal-horizon semiclassical QFT setting is not the adopted finite matrix postulate and does not establish its premises.

contents.name: §2.5, equations (38)–(43): finite relative entropy and monotonicity

source_review.read_extent: The finite-dimensional relative-entropy definition, modular-energy/entropy identity, faithfulness discussion, and restriction monotonicity were inspected.
source_review.supports: Motivates the finite identity and inequality interface; the item proves its conclusion from the current finite-dimensional mathematical supplier.
source_review.limitations: Wall's later use additionally depends on horizon thermality and other physical assumptions; it is not the proof of this finite model theorem.

contents.name: §2.6–2.7: horizon and exterior-region GSL proof
contents.reason: The assigned theorem proves only the finite matrix deduction under its explicit balance postulate; it does not adopt Wall's horizon algebra, semiclassical Einstein equations, or exterior-region construction.

source_review.read_extent: The complete renormalization discussion was inspected, including Wall's statement that the separated renormalized energy/entropy relation is assumed in that proof.
source_review.supports: Supports the explicit warning that the balance identity is adopted and scheme-specific.
source_review.limitations: No renormalized continuum identity is imported into the finite-regulator postulate.
